description:
Department of the Treasury 
Market Research Purposes Only

1. Notice Type

THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE ONLY.
THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP), REQUEST FOR QUOTATIONS (RFQ), OR INVITATION FOR BIDS (IFB). NO SOLICITATION IS AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME.

This notice is issued in accordance with FAR Part 10 for market research and acquisition planning purposes only.

The Government does not intend to award a contract based on responses to this notice.

2. Requirement Description

Department of the Treasury is conducting market research to identify capable enterprise Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) web-based learning solution (content + platform + services). Responses will inform acquisition strategy, small business set-aside determination, and potential statement of work refinements.

Sources Sought Notice (SoS) is attached. (review document in its entirety before submission)

The Government seeks vendors capable of providing enterprise COTS web based learning solution.

3. Information Requested From Industry

Interested vendors shall submit a capability, technical, support, pricing approach, and other capabilities/constraints statements. (see SoS for response requirements)

Company Information

Organization name & Primary address
UEI number
CAGE Code
Business size under NAICS
Socioeconomic status (SB, 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB, etc.)
SAM registration confirmation
Technical and administrative points of contact

4. Submission Instructions

Responses are due:

April 2, 2026, at 1:00 PM (Eastern Time)

Submit via email to:
benjamin.mendelsohn@treasury.gov – Benjamin Mendelsohn
Christopher.Monosiet@treasury.gov – Christopher Monosiet

Subject Line: “Sources Sought Response — Enterprise COTS Learning Solution — [Company Name]”

6. Disclaimer

This notice is issued for market research purposes only and does not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract.

The Government will not reimburse costs incurred in responding to this notice.

DO NOT SUBMIT PROPOSALS OR PRICING.
